def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Power series expansion model for log10(|ID|/A)."""
    log_id = np.array([
        parameters[0] + parameters[1]*gate_voltage_abs + parameters[2]*drain_voltage_abs +
        parameters[3]*(gate_voltage_abs**2) + parameters[4]*(drain_voltage_abs**2) +
        parameters[5]*(gate_voltage_abs**3) + parameters[6]*(drain_voltage_abs**3) +
        parameters[7]*(gate_voltage_abs**2)*(drain_voltage_abs) +
        parameters[10]*(gate_voltage_abs)*(drain_voltage_abs)**2 +
        parameters[11]*(gate_voltage_abs)**2*(drain_voltage_abs)
    ])
    return np.log10(np.abs(1.0 / np.exp(log_id)))
